policy: Source watchlist and original research patterns; no code, screenshots, images, fonts, third-party component archives, API keys, runtime dependencies or applications imported. Per-item licensing and current technical compatibility must be rechecked before any reuse.
collectionRules: Use official docs, public repository README, release notes and documented registries first; do not crawl protected content or bypass account/paywall limits.
De-duplicate by canonical URL, ID, capability and relation to existing source/behavior; source discovery alone is not a new runnable asset.
Treat marketplace items, source repositories, plugin packages, screenshots, fonts and external images as separate rights objects.
Only promote a source beyond reference-only after author/version/license/attribution/dependencies/security and runnable quality review.
No background monitoring or automatic uploads implied by this catalog.

patterns.name: Registry item to editable block mapping / 注册表转可编辑区块
patterns.designContract: 用 manifest 将可安装源文件、依赖和预览 props 映射到编辑器的可选区块，不把研究条目伪装成可运行组件
patterns.accessibleFallback: 缺少 propsSchema、预览隔离或权利证据时仅链接文档；不渲染未知代码
patterns.failureModes: 组件缺失、依赖版本错配、slot 不受控、外部 JS 执行、来源授权未核
patterns.distinctFrom: IP-039 解决粘贴内容安全；本项定义资产索引到可编辑区块的发布准入

patterns.name: Permission-gated Agent canvas commands / 授权分层画布命令
patterns.designContract: 给 Agent 的 inspect/mutate/replace-export 工具单独分级授权，以可验证的节点命令和事务回执替代屏幕坐标脚本
patterns.accessibleFallback: 不支持 WebMCP 时允许显式导出 JSON/手动应用，不暗中模拟不可审计写操作
patterns.failureModes: 越权写入、HTML 注入、隐式全量重置、他人并发修改、工具 schema 不匹配
patterns.distinctFrom: IP-040 讨论协同 Undo；本项重点是外部 Agent 工具发现和权限护栏

patterns.name: Guest-first recoverable workspaces / 可恢复游客草稿
patterns.designContract: 访客创建页面时保存本地 Schema 与资源版本，明确草稿、只读分享快照和可写编辑密钥的边界
patterns.accessibleFallback: IndexedDB 不可用时提供 JSON 下载和导入；分享链接不应默认授予写入权
patterns.failureModes: 清缓存丢数据、分享链接泄漏、匿名公开上传滥用、过期版本不能恢复
patterns.distinctFrom: 现有页面示例强调视觉结构；本项聚焦不强制登录时的恢复与访问控制

patterns.name: Pinned provenance for reproducible remix / 锁版本作品复现清单
patterns.designContract: 分离原始素材 ID、发布版本/commit、资源授权、Token 和工作区局部改动，支持跨项目可追踪复现
patterns.accessibleFallback: 依赖或媒体不可访问时生成差异报告和静态参考，不宣称像素级一致
patterns.failureModes: 未锁定的 GitHub head、字体/图片跨域变化、依赖未授权、响应式断点漂移
patterns.distinctFrom: PR-018 是已有风格布局交接；本项要求来源与依赖锁定、可导入快照的证据
